entities.summary:
Tell Beydar is an Ancient Near Eastern archaeological site along the Khabur river in the modern Al-Hasakah Governorate, Syria about 30 kilometers north of the modern city of Hasake. It is connected by road to Al-Darbasiyah on the Turkish border in the north. In the
mid-third millennium BC it was the city of Nabada which was a provincial
center under the city of Nagar. It is known to have contained 5 large temples 
in the city center in that period. While it is not known with certainty what deities were worshiped in these temples, the god Šumugan has been suggested as one of them.
